name: bool_scalar_add

name: bool_vector_min

name: storage_atomic32
source: struct P{__storage__ float *data;unsigned count;}; __compute__ __workgroup_size__(1,1,1) void main(__push_constant__ const P *p){auto q=reinterpret_cast<__storage__ unsigned*>(p->data+3);atomicStore(q,4u);p->data[0]=atomicAdd(q,2u);p->data[1]=atomicLoad(q);p->data[2]=atomicCAS(q,6u,7u);p->data[3]=atomicLoad(q);}

name: volatile_vector
source: struct P{__storage__ float *data;unsigned count;}; __compute__ __workgroup_size__(1,1,1) void main(__push_constant__ const P *p){volatile float a[3]={p->data[0],p->data[1],p->data[2]};auto r=add(a,a);p->data[0]=r[0];p->data[1]=r[1];p->data[2]=r[2];}
